question_text:
Match the following :
(a)
Rela Dance
(i)
Kondagattujatara
(b)
Gusadi Dance
(ii)
Limbadrigutta
(c)
Mutyampeta
(iii) Koyas
(d)
Bhimgal
(iv) Gonds

(a)

(i)

(b) 
(ii) 
(c) 
(iii) 
(d) 
(iv) 
The correct answer is

